title: HT Global Circuits
description: htglobalcircuits.com Revenue $70.4 Million HT Global Circuits is a private American PCB maker founded in 1990 in St. Petersburg, Florida, with 36 years of experience, over 1 billion boards shipped and 2000 plus customers. Led by CEO Ahmad Hamadeh, it uses a Blended Factory Model, quick turn and ITAR work at US plants in St. Petersburg and Milwaukee plus volume production with partners in China, Taiwan and Thailand. Its specialty is hard gold and selective gold plating for connectors, Type II gold at 30 micro inches, plus rigid, flex, rigid flex, HDI, RF up to 77 GHz, metal core and heavy copper boards. The Milwaukee plant came from the 2017 buyout of Pho-Tronics, a 50 year mil aero maker certified to MIL-PRF-55110. It holds ISO 9001, 14001, IATF 16949, AS9100D, ISO 13485, ITAR and UL, serving aerospace, defense, automotive and medical clients. 115.63 against US Navy contract N00024-24-C-6230, DPAS DO-A7  The defense chain  NAVSEA contract, CAGE 19623, GCN
